name: stillpoint-web-robustness
description: Decoder failure-mode matrix for the Stillpoint web app (headless Chrome). Run from web/: npm --prefix test/robustness run <script>

scripts.matrix:dev: node matrix.mjs --target dev --flags default,nohwdec --faults none,hwlevel,hwfail-late:45 --clips o3,oa4 --strict --strict-faults
